detail.text: Sawmill 7/21. Hot and dry on the east side climb, pass itself is clear, tiny patch on the west ramp you can avoid. Sawmill Creek is barely a step across now. Woods Creek below was moving but fine at the crossing. Nobody needs traction on this one anymore.

detail.text: Sawmill 6/11. Continuous snow above the last switchbacks on the west side, firm crust at sunrise, no drama with spikes. East side melts fast, mostly dry below 10,000. Sawmill Creek crossing was knee high with a strong push at midday.

facts.text: Snow left State Lakes (10,400 ft) 30 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 31 (2024), May 30 (2025); 2023: readings jump by more than snow can

facts.text: At State Lakes (10,400 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 4.7 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026).

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: 4.7 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 25.7 in (2024), 23.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 20 and June 10, carried from the melt-out dates at State Lakes (10,400 ft) and Upper Tyndall Creek (11,500 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: State Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 909 ft below the pass; points to April 19 to June 14

evidence.name: Upper Tyndall Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 17, 191 ft above the pass; points to April 21 to June 6
